title: 光子晶片晶圓級光測試
titleEn: Wafer-level optical testing of photonic chips
subcategoryTitle: 光子測試、漂移與設計驗證
subcategoryTitleEn: Photonic test, drift and design verification
summary: 從晶圓位置、耦合去嵌入與量測統計拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate wafer position, coupling de-embedding and measurement statistics, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

stages.title: 座標與去嵌入
stages.description: 以三個技術單元檢查「座標與去嵌入」，每一單元交付設計模型及獨立判別證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units examine coordinates and de-embedding, each delivering a model and independent diagnostic evidence.

steps.title: 晶圓座標：模型與設計
steps.objective: 以「晶圓座標」建立可檢驗的物理模型，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a falsifiable physical model for wafer coordinates, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先以師傅示意確認「晶圓座標」的輸入、輸出與座標，再在學徒工作台完成對應元件或資料流的排列。缺口方向、晶粒索引與探測台座標需一致，否則缺陷可能被歸到錯誤晶粒。 用本單元的變數畫出至少兩種設計狀態，說明它們在「以未參與校正的標記檢查旋轉與平移殘差，保留原始晶粒圖。」的驗證中應有何差異；把待量測參數另列，不以動畫位置當成實際公差。
steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for wafer coordinates, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. Notch orientation, die indices and stage coordinates must agree to avoid assigning defects to the wrong die. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Check rotation and translation on withheld marks and retain the raw die map. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances.
steps.observation: 以未參與校正的標記檢查旋轉與平移殘差，保留原始晶粒圖。
steps.observationEn: Check rotation and translation on withheld marks and retain the raw die map.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：未測晶粒應自動算通過。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Untested dies automatically count as passes. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交晶圓座標的兩狀態模型、變數表，以及能由「以未參與校正的標記檢查旋轉與平移殘差，保留原始晶粒圖。」反駁模型的預測。
steps.checkEn: Submit two model states and a variable table for wafer coordinates, plus a falsifiable prediction using: Check rotation and translation on withheld marks and retain the raw die map.

knowledge.title: 量化模型與適用邊界
knowledge.text: IL(L)=αL+C；不確定度要按協方差傳播，共同校正誤差不一定獨立。 假設同波長、同偏振、同耦合器及線性長度模型；真實製程需多長度及重複樣本。
knowledge.textEn: IL(L)=αL+C; propagate covariance because common calibration errors need not be independent. Assume matched wavelength, polarization and couplers with linear length dependence; real processes need multiple lengths and repeats.

quiz.question: 要審查「晶圓座標」，哪項主張或驗證方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or verification is justified when reviewing wafer coordinates?
options: 缺口方向、晶粒索引與探測台座標需一致，否則缺陷可能被歸到錯誤晶粒。
未測晶粒應自動算通過。
單張外觀照片可以量得傳播損耗。
optionsEn: Notch orientation, die indices and stage coordinates must agree to avoid assigning defects to the wrong die.
Untested dies automatically count as passes.

quiz.explanationEn: Notch orientation, die indices and stage coordinates must agree to avoid assigning defects to the wrong die. Check rotation and translation on withheld marks and retain the raw die map.

steps.title: 晶圓座標：量測與判別
steps.objective: 以「晶圓座標」區分機制並作出有證據的驗收決定，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate mechanisms and make an evidence-based acceptance decision for wafer coordinates, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 保留上一作業的模型，現在檢驗它是否足以解釋觀察。以未參與校正的標記檢查旋轉與平移殘差，保留原始晶粒圖。 記錄原始量、單位、基準與重複量測差異；以支持及否定各一項證據比較「缺口方向、晶粒索引與探測台座標需一致，否則缺陷可能被歸到錯誤晶粒。」與錯誤假說「單張外觀照片可以量得傳播損耗。」，最後提出放行、重測或修模決定。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and test whether it explains the observations. Check rotation and translation on withheld marks and retain the raw die map. Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "Notch orientation, die indices and stage coordinates must agree to avoid assigning defects to the wrong die." against the incorrect hypothesis "One exterior photograph measures propagation loss."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model.
steps.observation: 以未參與校正的標記檢查旋轉與平移殘差，保留原始晶粒圖。
steps.observationEn: Check rotation and translation on withheld marks and retain the raw die map.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：單張外觀照片可以量得傳播損耗。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: One exterior photograph measures propagation loss. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交晶圓座標的量測判別表：以未參與校正的標記檢查旋轉與平移殘差，保留原始晶粒圖。 附上基準、重複性或不確定度，及不能由本資料判定的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit a measurement-discrimination table for wafer coordinates: Check rotation and translation on withheld marks and retain the raw die map. Include the reference, repeatability or uncertainty, and conclusions the data cannot support.

steps.instruction: 先以師傅示意確認「切回法斜率」的輸入、輸出與座標，再在學徒工作台完成對應元件或資料流的排列。同型耦合器與不同波導長度可分離長度相關損耗和共同截距；耦合器差異會污染斜率。 用本單元的變數畫出至少兩種設計狀態，說明它們在「重算教學算例，再以重複結構估計耦合器散布與斜率信賴區間。」的驗證中應有何差異；把待量測參數另列，不以動畫位置當成實際公差。 假設同型耦合器的 1 cm 與 3 cm 波導總損耗分別為 5.2 與 6.0 dB：α=(6.0−5.2)/(3−1)=0.40 dB/cm；共同截距=4.8 dB。若兩次獨立量測的標準不確定度各 0.10 dB，u(α)=√2×0.10/2=0.071 dB/cm，未含長度或耦合器變異。
steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for cutback slope, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. Matched couplers and different lengths separate propagation slope and common intercept; coupler mismatch contaminates the slope. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Recalculate the example and use repeated structures to estimate coupler scatter and a slope confidence interval. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances. Assume matched-coupler waveguides of 1 and 3 cm have 5.2 and 6.0 dB total loss. α=(6.0−5.2)/(3−1)=0.40 dB/cm and intercept=4.8 dB. Two independent 0.10 dB standard uncertainties give u(α)=0.071 dB/cm, excluding length and coupler variation.

knowledge.title: 量化模型與適用邊界
knowledge.text: IL(L)=αL+C；不確定度要按協方差傳播，共同校正誤差不一定獨立。 假設同波長、同偏振、同耦合器及線性長度模型；真實製程需多長度及重複樣本。
knowledge.textEn: IL(L)=αL+C; propagate covariance because common calibration errors need not be independent. Assume matched wavelength, polarization and couplers with linear length dependence; real processes need multiple lengths and repeats.

quiz.question: 要審查「切回法斜率」，哪項主張或驗證方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or verification is justified when reviewing cutback slope?
options: 未測晶粒應自動算通過。
同型耦合器與不同波導長度可分離長度相關損耗和共同截距；耦合器差異會污染斜率。
共同校正誤差在所有運算中都完全獨立。
optionsEn: Untested dies automatically count as passes.
Matched couplers and different lengths separate propagation slope and common intercept; coupler mismatch contaminates the slope.
Common calibration errors are independent in every calculation.
quiz.explanation: 同型耦合器與不同波導長度可分離長度相關損耗和共同截距；耦合器差異會污染斜率。 重算教學算例，再以重複結構估計耦合器散布與斜率信賴區間。
quiz.explanationEn: Matched couplers and different lengths separate propagation slope and common intercept; coupler mismatch contaminates the slope. Recalculate the example and use repeated structures to estimate coupler scatter and a slope confidence interval.

steps.title: 切回法斜率：量測與判別
steps.objective: 以「切回法斜率」區分機制並作出有證據的驗收決定，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate mechanisms and make an evidence-based acceptance decision for cutback slope, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 保留上一作業的模型，現在檢驗它是否足以解釋觀察。重算教學算例，再以重複結構估計耦合器散布與斜率信賴區間。 記錄原始量、單位、基準與重複量測差異；以支持及否定各一項證據比較「同型耦合器與不同波導長度可分離長度相關損耗和共同截距；耦合器差異會污染斜率。」與錯誤假說「未測晶粒應自動算通過。」，最後提出放行、重測或修模決定。 假設同型耦合器的 1 cm 與 3 cm 波導總損耗分別為 5.2 與 6.0 dB：α=(6.0−5.2)/(3−1)=0.40 dB/cm；共同截距=4.8 dB。若兩次獨立量測的標準不確定度各 0.10 dB，u(α)=√2×0.10/2=0.071 dB/cm，未含長度或耦合器變異。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and test whether it explains the observations. Recalculate the example and use repeated structures to estimate coupler scatter and a slope confidence interval. Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "Matched couplers and different lengths separate propagation slope and common intercept; coupler mismatch contaminates the slope." against the incorrect hypothesis "Untested dies automatically count as passes."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model. Assume matched-coupler waveguides of 1 and 3 cm have 5.2 and 6.0 dB total loss. α=(6.0−5.2)/(3−1)=0.40 dB/cm and intercept=4.8 dB. Two independent 0.10 dB standard uncertainties give u(α)=0.071 dB/cm, excluding length and coupler variation.
steps.observation: 重算教學算例，再以重複結構估計耦合器散布與斜率信賴區間。
steps.observationEn: Recalculate the example and use repeated structures to estimate coupler scatter and a slope confidence interval.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：未測晶粒應自動算通過。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Untested dies automatically count as passes. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交切回法斜率的量測判別表：重算教學算例，再以重複結構估計耦合器散布與斜率信賴區間。 附上基準、重複性或不確定度，及不能由本資料判定的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit a measurement-discrimination table for cutback slope: Recalculate the example and use repeated structures to estimate coupler scatter and a slope confidence interval. Include the reference, repeatability or uncertainty, and conclusions the data cannot support.
